sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Patagonia is the only major apparel brand that has successfully transitioned its entire ownership structure to a non-profit model where all profits not reinvested in the business are used to protect the planet.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Patagonia is an American designer and retailer of outdoor clothing and gear, widely recognized for its environmental activism and sustainable business practices. Founded in 1973 by Yvon Chouinard, the company is headquartered in Ventura, California, and operates as a benefit corporation that directs its profits toward climate change mitigation.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Outdoor apparel (jackets
fleece
base layers)
technical gear (wetsuits
backpacks
climbing equipment)
and regenerative organic food.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Outdoor enthusiasts, environmental activists, high-income conscious consumers, and technical athletes.
